hypothesis: L008 showed that using hist_gradient_boosting/raw only for cu_o improved positive-Tc MAE from 8.5051 K to 8.3382 K and high-Tc MAE from 28.8502 K to 27.8571 K, but sharply worsened reported-zero MAE from 6.0806 K to 7.1123 K and therefore worsened pooled MAE. Changing only that cu_o expert to hist_gradient_boosting/log1p may suppress its extreme overprediction of reported-zero cuprates enough to improve pooled MAE, while retaining A05's extra_trees/raw other expert and fe_anion fallback.
falsification: The hypothesis is falsified as an eligible improvement if pooled weighted OOF MAE is not below 7.742598770753422 K, representing the required 0.01 K gain over A05, or if positive-Tc MAE exceeds the fixed G01 guard of 8.832165507919859 K. Improvements confined to reported-zero cases would remain a subgroup tradeoff if either condition fails.
reason: The continuation minimum is pending, and this is an untried target-only ablation of L008 that directly tests whether target compression can correct its observed cu_o zero-versus-positive tradeoff.
